name: Verify hash of copied data matches the hash of the data read from source device
description:
Compares a hash of data read from a source device with a hash computed by reading back the copy of that data stored in a raw image or a forensic image container. 

The source hash may be computed as the data is read during imaging, or by reading the source device again at a later point. 

What distinguishes this technique is that the reference hash comes from reading the source device, rather than from a stored record of that hash. Comparison against a stored hash, whether inside the image file, in a separate file, or held externally, is covered by DFT-1204.
